HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
